item.title: Women’s progress at work is stalling
item.description:
"Explore the challenges facing women in the workplace and the factors contributing to the stall in their progress. Tune in to our latest podcast episode, 'Women's Progress at Work is Stalling', for insightful discussions and expert analysis on achieving gender equality in the corporate world." (155 characters, including spaces)
Alternatively, a more concise version: "Discussing the obstacles to women's career advancement and strategies for change in our latest podcast episode, 'Women's Progress at Work is Stalling'." (130 characters, including spaces)
